title: Family Fun Night
excerpt: Join us for an unforgettable evening of laughter, friendly competition, and community! Bring your family, invite your neighbors, and come ready to play, snack, and connect
body:
🎉 Family Fun Night – Minute to Win It Games & Prizes! 🎉

Join us for an exciting Family Fun Night filled with fast-paced, Minute to Win It-style games where you can compete for awesome prizes! Bring your family, friends, and neighbors for an evening of laughter, friendly competition, and delicious treats.

🍋 Lemonade Bar – Mix and match flavors to create your perfect drink!
🍿 Popcorn Bar – Load up your popcorn with sweet and savory toppings!

This event is FREE and open to the public—everyone is welcome! Whether you're a game master or just looking for a fun night out, we’d love to have you.

📅 Date: 7/27/25
⏰ Time: Starts at 6:00 PM
📍 Location: First Baptist Church of Capac in Fellowship Hall (106 W Church St., Capac, MI 48014)

Invite your friends and come ready for a night of family-friendly fun! See you there!

title: Teen Vacation Bible Study
excerpt: Join Us for Teen Vacation Bible School! Join us for two enjoyable evenings of learning about the hope we have in Christ. Your teen will discover God’s love in a whole new way.
body:
Join Us for Teen Vacation Bible School! Join us for two enjoyable evenings of learning about the hope we have in Christ. Your teen will discover God’s love in a whole new way. Feel free to come and join in the fun and make some new friends!. We’ll meet a few minutes ahead of time in the parking lot.

Saturday and Sunday

title: Family Movie Night
excerpt: Rev up your engines and join us for a high-octane Family Movie Night at First Baptist Church of Capac! We're rolling out the red carpet for a fun-filled evening featuring Disney Pixar's Cars. Get ready for Lightning McQueen, Mater, and the whole Radiator Springs crew to race into your hearts!
body:
🚗✨ Family Movie Night: "Cars" Under the Stars! ✨🚗

Rev up your engines and join us for a high-octane night of fun, faith, and family as we screen Disney-Pixar’s Cars!

📅 Date: August 22, 2025
⏰ Time: Starting at 7:00 PM
📍 Location: Fellowship Hall Parking Lot

Bring your crew, lawn chairs, and your need for speed! We’ll have:
🍿 Free popcorn & lemonade

This is a free event for all ages, so invite your friends, neighbors, and fellow Cars fans! Let’s make memories and celebrate community together.

"And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds." — Hebrews 10:24 (NIV)

Just show up—we’d wheelie love to see you there!

title: Family Trivia Night
excerpt: It’s trivia time! Gather your smartest friends and join us for a night of fun, fellowship, and friendly competition.
body:
🧠✨ Church-Wide Trivia Night: "Brainiacs & Believers!" ✨🧠

It’s trivia time! Gather your smartest friends and join us for a night of fun, fellowship, and friendly competition.

📅 Date: April 18, 2026
⏰ Time: 7:00 PM
📍 Location: Fellowship Hall

Kids vs. Adults! From math, science and a little good-natured Bible trivia. No expertise required, just bring your curiosity!

We’ll Provide:
🍿 Snacks
🍋 Lemonade
📝 All game materials & questions
🏆 Prizes for the top teams!

This is a free, all-ages event, perfect for inviting friends, family, and neighbors. Come for the trivia, stay for the community!

"A merry heart does good, like medicine, but a broken spirit dries the bones." Proverbs 17:22 (NKJV)

No sign-up needed—just come ready to play. We quiz-itely hope to see you there!

title: Thanksgiving Service
excerpt:
🍂🦃 Join Us for a Special Thanksgiving Service! 🦃🍂

We are gathering as a church family to pause, reflect, and give thanks for the countless blessings God has poured into our lives. There is no better way to start the week than in His presence with a grateful heart.
body:
🍂🦃 Join Us for a Special Thanksgiving Service! 🦃🍂

We are gathering as a church family to pause, reflect, and give thanks for the countless blessings God has poured into our lives. There is no better way to start the week than in His presence with a grateful heart.

Whether you have had a mountain-top year or a valley season, come as you are. Let’s celebrate God's faithfulness together!

⏰ Time: 11:00 AM
📍 Where: 106 W Church St, Capac, MI 48014

"Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good; his love endures forever." - Psalm 107:1

We can't wait to worship with you! Bring a friend!

title: Christmas Program
body:

title: Christmas Eve Service
body: Join us for a heartwarming Christmas Eve service at First Baptist Church of Capac! As we gather to celebrate the birth of Jesus, we invite you to experience the joy, peace, and hope that this special night brings. Our service will feature beautiful music, inspiring messages, and a sense of community that will fill your heart with the true spirit of Christmas. Bring your family and friends to share in this meaningful tradition and create lasting memories together. We look forward to welcoming you!
